paragraphs.text: Krond is a legendary archon from an unknown plane.

Krond, the Dawn-Clad is a striking figure from an unknown plane, embodying the essence of justice and the brilliance of dawn. As an Archon , Krond is a celestial being deeply aligned with the principles of order, known for imposing moral order and retribution. He appears as a golden man riding atop a majestic winged lion, both rider and steed resplendent in a unified golden hue.

Krond is described as the personification of dawn's light, a being who lives to exact justice. He has a nemesis, Vela , the Night-Clad , who represents the opposing force of nightfall. Their eternal conflict symbolizes the cosmic struggle between light and darkness, order and chaos, justice and malevolence.
